text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Trainer and Tosen Jordan trained hard, 
aiming for the Spring Senior Triple Crown 
starting with the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Even if others called the training 
foolish... she kept doing what needed to 
be done."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Osaka Hai. Tosen Jordan 
declares war on Gold Ship, proclaiming: 
"I'm gonna be an even bigger idiot than 
you!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, Gold Ship smiled, thoroughly 
amused.
